disposition_reason: Rat dietary iron loading (650 vs 45 mg/kg) with fractionated gamma radiation; oxidative-stress endpoints; no food occurrence data.

study.method: Serum analytes, 8-OHdG immunohistochemistry, qRT-PCR gene panels

regulatory_or_exposure: Experimental diets 45 mg iron/kg (adequate) and 650 mg iron/kg (high) (Methods p. 5; Results p. 2)
High-iron diet raised plasma iron 33% and liver iron 26% (Results p. 2, from companion report)
Astronaut intake stated as 20 ± 6 mg/day, up to 47 mg/day (Introduction p. 2, background)
non_numeric_findings: High dietary iron altered the radiation response of catalase, glutathione peroxidase and total antioxidant capacity.
Retina and aorta gene expression suggested an interaction between iron loading and radiation.
